notes.content: [p]Patch 1.30 :[/p][list][*][p]Gave Zan's 3D model ears. (That's right. I, and hundreds of players, somehow didn't notice.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a glitch where chapter 15 felt like nothing was interactable in case you got in a fight with a duo of characters in chapter 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor typo fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.29 : The french gender update
notes.content:
This update mostly contains fixes in the french texts where the player was misgendered.
Also, you can now leave the University with mouse controls!

notes.title: Minor patchnotes 1.28 : Audio balancing
notes.content: [p]This update is small ! [/p][p]- A source of audio mixing glitches was found and fixed in the entire game ; your volume preferences should be correctly applied [/p][p]- typo fixes, as usual [/p][p]- When blinking for the first time, randomly generated birds had a small chance of changing their robes color. This magic isn't canonical to the world of Six Legends, so it was removed.[/p][p]- In Chapter 5, Krock could encourage the Amphibian Chief to break the laws of physics by running around him.[/p]

notes.title: The Spoiler Update
notes.content:
You finished the game.
You loved the surprise.
You loved it so much that you wish there was more?

You can now [spoiler] export your dragon in the 3D format GLTF! [/spoiler]

notes.title: Six Legends releases on the Year of the Dragon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44854494/3a92ecb72a2dd22a80b985aae4d72fd1f175e78c.png[/img]
[h1]HERE WE ARE[/h1]
Some of you have been waiting since October, some even earlier, but even if you're just finding out about it, it's finally time to experience the unique story of Six Legends!


[h1]Welcome to Six Legends[/h1]
Dragons, twists, choices, minigames, characters, culture shock, romance and a lot more are waiting for you in this gameplay-mix, narrative-focused game! You are [b]not[/b] ready for everything that is going to happen!


And the story? Oh man, the story!
[h2]Once you pick it up, you won't put it back down![/h2]


Come and experience the game! Still unsure? there is a 3 hours long demo, for free!
You can share your experience on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pTpDFhWdGC]official Discord[/url], I sincerely hope it'll be a good one!
